title: Purple Sorceress with Crescent
description: A young female character with light purple hair stands in a dynamic pose against a solid gray background. She wears traditional East Asian-inspired white and purple robes with armor elements, holds a glowing purple crescent moon blade in her right hand, and channels swirling purple energy from her left hand while a magical halo of lightning floats above her head.
prompt: A young East Asian female sorceress with pale lavender hair in buns and ornaments, wearing white and purple traditional robes with purple sash and armor accents, stands in a combat stance. Dynamic pose, clean digital anime illustration style, solid gray background.
